1.en_consolidated_definition:
To animate 

to encourage or inspire someone or something to take action or become more lively or enthusiastic.

to enliven or revitalize something, such as a place or an event.

to give energy or vitality to something, making it more engaging or interesting.

Note: In some contexts, this verb may also imply the idea of "animación" (animation) in Puerto Rican culture, referring to the process of bringing art, music, or other creative expressions to life.
